attachments.insertion_landmark: posterior proximal tibia (above the soleal line)

actions: unlocks the knee from terminal-extension screw-home rotation by internally rotating the tibia on the femur (or externally rotating the femur on a fixed tibia)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Its origin tendon runs intra-articularly (inside the knee joint capsule) before the muscle belly proper begins -- a distinctive anatomical relationship among lower-limb muscles.
functional_compartments.source: Ward SR, Eng CM, Smallwood LH, Lieber RL (2009) Clin Orthop Relat Res 467:1074-1082 -- lower-extremity muscle architecture (fascicle length, PCSA, sarcomere length) cadaver dataset
